pre_condition: caller_fqn is a non-empty FQN string. callee_names is an iterable of string names (the callee names from .info.json entries whose expected spec changed). callees_map is a dict whose keys include caller_fqn and whose values are iterables of callee FQN strings (the call graph). edge_aliases_map, if non-None, is a dict with callee-FQN keys, each mapping to a dict of caller-FQN → iterable of alias strings (supplemental edge alias info).
post_condition: Returns a set containing every callee FQN from callees_map[caller_fqn] for which at least one of the following holds: (a) the final ::-delimited component (stem) of that FQN is equal, case-insensitively, to a non-empty, non-whitespace-only member of callee_names after stripping; (b) at least one alias recorded for that callee under caller_fqn in edge_aliases_map is equal, case-insensitively, to such a member of callee_names. Empty and whitespace-only callee_names are ignored. Returns the empty set when no callee FQN satisfies either matching condition. Matching is case-insensitive. Multiple callee FQNs sharing the same stem are all resolved and returned.
